The topics and dates of future lectures may change.

Spring quarter runs from Tuesday, March 30 to Friday, June 11, 2027,
with finals week from Monday, June 7 to Friday, June 11.
Class meets on Mondays, Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Fridays, 9:00--9:50am, in CF 420.
There is no class on Monday, May 31, for Memorial Day.

Monday to Wednesday are lectures from these notes.
Most Fridays are lab sessions, for working on the homework in class.

Homework is due at 11:59 pm on its due date, always a Friday.
Each self-grade is due one week after that homework's solutions are posted;
the self-grade dates below assume the solutions go up at the deadline.

Midterms 1, 2 and 3 are in class on Monday, April 26, Monday, May 17 and Tuesday, June 1.
Midterm 1 covers weeks 1 to 3, from the course overview through optimization.
Midterm 2 covers regularization and normalization, convolutional networks, sequence models and language modeling.
Midterm 3 covers the lectures from attention through running deep learning experiments.
Each midterm has an in-class review session on the Friday before the exam.

The final exam is optional.
Its day and time are still to be set (TBD):
WWU's [finals schedule](https://registrar.wwu.edu/calendars/finals) sets each exam's slot
from the class's start time and meeting days.
The final's review session will be held during finals week, at a time TBD.
